name: Serath Cloudberry-Mango Tonic
description: A premium tonic water blending real cloudberry extract with mango and a quinine-botanical blend. Intended as a mixer but increasingly consumed straight by Tier 3-4 consumers who appreciate its restrained bitterness.
flavor_profile: Tart, jammy cloudberry with tropical mango warmth and the clean bitter finish of quinine. Elegant carbonation. Dry and sophisticated — not sweet-led.
cultural_context: Serath Botanical Tonics occupies a unique market position as both a mixer brand and a standalone soda — its bottles appear at Tier 4 cocktail bars and on Tier 3 dinner tables with equal frequency. Cloudberry is expensive and difficult to source synthetically without losing its distinctive tartness, which keeps Serath's price point high and its customer base self-selecting.
story_hooks: Serath's cloudberry supply comes from a single Nordic vertical farm cooperative — a catastrophic equipment failure has wiped out this season's crop, and Serath must decide whether to substitute synth-cloudberry and risk its reputation or go dark for a season.
A Tier 5 Spire resident has become obsessed with Serath and has been buying the entire output of specific production runs — no one knows why, and Serath's distribution is suffering.

Serath's quinine-botanical blend contains a trace compound that interacts unexpectedly with a newly popular augmentation upgrade — the effect is pleasant but entirely unintended, and word is getting out.
